concept.retina: User clarification: overlapping pixel layers, not merely high pixel density. Retain 4x16x208 input and align each row to inherited native path into 49-bin strip, no interpolation or new resolution. Stack 4 disjoint 4-row blocks as four registered 4x49 pixel planes per scan. Compare mean, minimum, positive occupancy and variance at corresponding cells; leave-one-layer-out contrasts. Separate ON1/OFF1/ON2/OFF2 layers, primary and repeat pairs; do not pool them indiscriminately. Optional composite ON minus OFF and shared minimum; no physical inference from display analogy.
concept.pixel_matrix: Native aligned pixels and exact four layer overlay. Calculate core and surrounding profile, positive overlap of >=3/4 temporal layers, core-vs-shoulder contrast of average/median/min layers, between-layer dispersion, held-out layer support; no interpolating or filling cells. Keep signed measurements, overlapping intensity not independent evidence.
concept.rubik: Reversible coordinate rotation and axis transpose exact, plus independently rotated 4-row slabs along aligned frequency axis. 32 fixed shifts per scan, seed 413201, shifts ±6..18. Compare actual layer overlap and minimum-layer core contrast against shifted layer null q90. Inverse exact. Not calibrated p-values; path fixed and chosen on primary data; controls preserve row distributions and short-block shape. No exchange of physical ON/OFF roles.

scope: All 11 previously viewed groups, 3168 examples; all 891 source-qualified baseline alerts, 409 audit. Verify R41S1C archive and 22 hashes and exact full parent trace replay. Append evidence state, do not mutate baseline/roles/path/no training/no veto/no Penrose. Primary injection may not exist in independent repeat; do not reject non-repeat. Report parent/rescue separately; descriptive AUC only, no threshold selection.

simulation.expected_directions: Coherent narrow > scrambled on overlay positive overlap and null excess; narrow > broad on concentration; shared OFF contrast > target-only; report weak and noise descriptively. No tuned thresholds.

gate: Technical PASS if rotation and inverse exact, all parent trace parity, 891 diagnostics, zero decisions changed. Synthetic direction outcomes reported independently even if fail; science HOLD pending genuinely new observations. No claim 53->35 in this run.
clarification: Retina is an Apple high-resolution display designation, not inherently stacked pixels; literal stacked emitting layers are a different display technology. Adopt user's layer-overlay analogy as a data operator, not hardware claim.
